scope: Independent source-only review of the exact-value Cancel repair, the acceptance runner surrounding assertions, and its implementation report. No browser, build, or test was launched; no isolation behavior was changed.

verdict_a_runtime.reason: This lane did not execute the acceptance runner or observe the native side panel.

prior_finding.evidence: SESSION_VALUE is seeded into the isolated session fixture; storageState exposes only sessionFixtureMatches (strict equality to the expected value); seeding waits for that match, and the post-Cancel assertion requires it to remain true. This detects value corruption while the key remains present.

verdict_b_source_quality.secret_data_review: The fixture value is not returned by storageState, written to the report, or included in the Cancel assertion failure; only the Boolean match result is observed.
